Fixed workflow rails:
[RL-0020] If the proposed clustering units are entities but the input rows are repeated transactions, the Navigator must recommend build_entities before a distribution-only EDA action completes the event. In that entity-building step, before the split, the Worker builds one row per entity: drop rows without an entity key, handle reversing rows (negative amounts, returns) by an explicit rule printed in one line, and aggregate deterministically (recency against the last date in the table, frequency, total and mean value), with no fitted transform. Save the declared prepared-data artifact so the engine freezes the entity rows. Do not aggregate after partitioning or pretend transaction-level clustering satisfies an entity-level aim.
